examples/blocks.agc:
# Blocks are functions written at the call site. They capture the values
# they can see when they are created.
struct Item
  name: String
  price: Float
  stock: Int
end

def apply_discount(items: List[Item], rule: Fn[Item, Float]) -> List[Item]
  return items.map do |item|
    Item(name: item.name, price: rule.call(item), stock: item.stock)
  end
end

def main() -> Void
  items = [
    Item(name: "tea", price: 4.0, stock: 3),
    Item(name: "coffee", price: 9.5, stock: 0),
    Item(name: "cocoa", price: 6.0, stock: 12)
  ]
  rate = 0.5
  cheaper = apply_discount(items) do |item|
    if item.stock > 10
      return item.price * rate
    end
    item.price
  end
  in_stock = cheaper.filter do |item| item.stock > 0 end
  by_price = in_stock.sort_by do |item| item.price end
  by_price.each do |item|
    puts("#{item.name}: #{item.price}")
  end
  total = in_stock.reduce(0) do |sum, item| sum + item.stock end
  puts("units: #{total}")
  empty = items.any? do |item| item.stock == 0 end
  puts("any empty: #{empty}")
end

struct Work
  value: Int
  delay: Int
end

def double(work: Work) -> Int
  Task.sleep(work.delay)
  return work.value * 2
end

def main() -> Void
  first = Task.spawn(&double, Work(value: 21, delay: 10))
  second = Task.spawn(&double, Work(value: 7, delay: 0))
  puts(String.from_int(Task.await(first)))
  puts(String.from_int(Task.await(second)))
end

# Module constants: values fixed for the whole run, written in capitals.

# A literal is part of the bytecode; the other values are built once, before main.
WIDTH = 8
PAGE_SIZE = WIDTH * 4
SEPARATOR = " | "

# A table built once; a function that runs many times only reads it.
PRICES = {"tea": 3, "cocoa": 5, "kiwi": 2}
FRUITS = Set.new(["kiwi", "apple"])
LABELS = PRICES.keys().map do |name| name.upcase() end

# A constant may read one that is declared later in the file.
SUMMARY = "#{WIDTH}#{SEPARATOR}#{PAGE_SIZE}"

def kind(name: String) -> String
  if FRUITS.include?(name)
    return "fruit"
  end
  return "drink"
end

def main() -> Void
  puts(SUMMARY)
  puts(PRICES.get("cocoa", 0))
  puts(kind("kiwi") + SEPARATOR + kind("tea"))
  puts(LABELS.size)
end

examples/http_server.agc:
import HTTP from "std/http"

def handle(request: HttpRequest) -> Result[HttpResponse]
  if request.method == "GET" and request.path == "/"
    return ok(HttpResponse(status: 200, headers: [Header(name: "Content-Type", value: "text/plain; charset=utf-8")], body: "hello\n"))
  end
  return ok(HttpResponse(status: 404, headers: [], body: "not found\n"))
end

def main() -> Void
  server = HTTP.listen("127.0.0.1", 0, &handle, HTTP.server_options()).unwrap!
  if System.args().length == 1 and System.args()[0] == "serve"
    puts(HTTP.local_port(server))
    IO.flush()
    HTTP.wait(server).unwrap!
    return
  end
  client = HTTP.client(HTTP.client_options()).unwrap!
  base = "http://127.0.0.1:#{HTTP.local_port(server)}"
  response = HTTP.get(client, base + "/").unwrap!
  puts(response.status)
  puts(response.body)
  puts(HTTP.get(client, base + "/missing").unwrap!.status)
  HTTP.close_client(client)
  HTTP.close_server(server)
  IO.inspect(HTTP.wait(server))
end

  root = try JSON.parse(text)
  entries = try JSON.list(root)
  totals: Map[String, Int] = {}
  for entry in entries
    category = try JSON.string(try JSON.get(entry, "category"))
    amount = try JSON.int(try JSON.get(entry, "amount"))

examples/knight-tour.agc:
struct Move
  dx: Int
  dy: Int
end

struct Tour
  found: Bool
  path: List[Int]
end

def destinations(size: Int, square: Int, visited: List[Bool]) -> List[Int]
  moves = [Move(dx: 1, dy: 2), Move(dx: 2, dy: 1), Move(dx: 2, dy: -1), Move(dx: 1, dy: -2), Move(dx: -1, dy: -2), Move(dx: -2, dy: -1), Move(dx: -2, dy: 1), Move(dx: -1, dy: 2)]
  result: List[Int] = []
  for move in moves
    x = square % size + move.dx
    y = square / size + move.dy
    if x >= 0 and x < size and y >= 0 and y < size
      next = y * size + x
      if not visited[next]
        result = List.append(result, next)
      end
    end
  end
  return result
end

def search(size: Int, square: Int, visited: List[Bool], path: List[Int]) -> Result[List[Int]]
  marked = List.set(visited, square, true)
  route = List.append(path, square)
  if List.size(route) == size * size
    return ok(route)
  end
  candidates = destinations(size, square, marked)
  attempted = List.repeat(false, List.size(candidates))
  remaining = List.size(candidates)
  while remaining > 0
    best = -1
    degree = 9
    index = 0
    for candidate in candidates
      if not attempted[index]
        exits = List.size(destinations(size, candidate, marked))
        if exits < degree
          best = index
          degree = exits
        end
      end
      index = index + 1
    end
    attempted = List.set(attempted, best, true)
    result = search(size, candidates[best], marked, route)
    if Result.ok?(result)
      return result
    end
    remaining = remaining - 1
  end
  return error("no tour")
end

def solve(text: String) -> Result[Tour]
  request = try JSON.parse(text)
  size = try JSON.int(try JSON.get(request, "size"))
  start = try JSON.int(try JSON.get(request, "start"))
  if size < 1 or size > 8
    return error("invalid input")
  end
  if start < 0 or start >= size * size
    return error("invalid input")
  end
  result = search(size, start, List.repeat(false, size * size), [])
  if Result.ok?(result)
    return ok(Tour(found: true, path: Result.unwrap!(result)))
  end
  return ok(Tour(found: false, path: []))
end

def main() -> Void
  result = solve(IO.read())
  if Result.ok?(result)
    puts(JSON.encode(Result.unwrap!(result)))
  else
    puts(JSON.encode({"error": "invalid input"}))
  end
end
examples/maze-bfs.agc:
struct Maze
  width: Int
  height: Int
  cells: Map[Int, Bool]
  start: Int
  goal: Int
end

struct Route
  found: Bool
  distance: Int
  path: List[Int]
end

def read_maze(text: String) -> Result[Maze]
  request = try JSON.parse(text)
  rows = try JSON.list(try JSON.get(request, "grid"))
  height = List.size(rows)
  if height < 1 or height > 32
    return error("invalid input")
  end
  width = 0
  cells: Map[Int, Bool] = {}
  row_index = 0
  for row in rows
    line = try JSON.string(row)
    if row_index == 0
      width = String.length(line)
    end
    if width < 1 or width > 32 or String.length(line) != width
      return error("invalid input")
    end
    column = 0
    for cell in String.split(line, "")
      if cell == "."
        cells = Map.put(cells, row_index * width + column, true)
      elsif cell != "#"
        return error("invalid input")
      end
      column = column + 1
    end
    row_index = row_index + 1
  end
  start = try JSON.int(try JSON.get(request, "start"))
  goal = try JSON.int(try JSON.get(request, "goal"))
  if start < 0 or start >= width * height or goal < 0 or goal >= width * height
    return error("invalid input")
  end
  if not Map.get(cells, start, false) or not Map.get(cells, goal, false)
    return error("invalid input")
  end
  return ok(Maze(width: width, height: height, cells: cells, start: start, goal: goal))
end

def neighbors(maze: Maze, square: Int) -> List[Int]
  x = square % maze.width
  y = square / maze.width
  result: List[Int] = []
  if y > 0
    result = List.append(result, square - maze.width)
  end
  if x + 1 < maze.width
    result = List.append(result, square + 1)
  end
  if y + 1 < maze.height
    result = List.append(result, square + maze.width)
  end
  if x > 0
    result = List.append(result, square - 1)
  end
  return result
end

def reconstruct(start: Int, goal: Int, previous: Map[Int, Int]) -> List[Int]
  path: List[Int] = []
  current = goal
  while current != start
    path = List.append(path, current)
    current = Result.unwrap!(Map.get(previous, current))
  end
  return List.reverse(List.append(path, start))
end

def shortest_route(maze: Maze) -> Route
  queue: Map[Int, Int] = {}
  queue = Map.put(queue, 0, maze.start)
  distances: Map[Int, Int] = {}
  distances = Map.put(distances, maze.start, 0)
  previous: Map[Int, Int] = {}
  head = 0
  tail = 1
  while Map.size(queue) > 0
    current = Result.unwrap!(Map.get(queue, head))
    queue = Map.delete(queue, head)
    head = head + 1
    distance = Result.unwrap!(Map.get(distances, current))
    if current == maze.goal
      return Route(found: true, distance: distance, path: reconstruct(maze.start, maze.goal, previous))
    end
    for next in neighbors(maze, current)
      if Map.get(maze.cells, next, false) and not Result.ok?(Map.get(distances, next))
        distances = Map.put(distances, next, distance + 1)
        previous = Map.put(previous, next, current)
        queue = Map.put(queue, tail, next)
        tail = tail + 1
      end
    end
  end
  return Route(found: false, distance: -1, path: [])
end

def main() -> Void
  maze = read_maze(IO.read())
  if Result.ok?(maze)
    puts(JSON.encode(shortest_route(Result.unwrap!(maze))))
  else
    puts(JSON.encode({"error": "invalid input"}))
  end
end
examples/mcp/stdio.agc:
# Minimal MCP stdio server: initialize, ping, and an empty tools/list.
# Run: dist/agentica examples/mcp/stdio.agc
# One JSON-RPC message per line; stdout is reserved for protocol replies.

struct Envelope
  jsonrpc: String
  method: String
end

struct RpcResponse
  jsonrpc: String
  id: Json
  result: Json
end

struct RpcError
  code: Int
  message: String
end

struct EmptyObject
end

struct ServerInfo
  name: String
  version: String
end

struct Capabilities
  tools: EmptyObject
end

struct InitializeResult
  protocolVersion: String
  capabilities: Capabilities
  serverInfo: ServerInfo
end

struct ToolsResult
  tools: List[Json]
end

# Responses have different struct types; share only the text transport.
def send_message(text: String) -> Void
  puts(text)
  IO.flush()
end

def reply(id: Json, result: Json) -> Void
  response = RpcResponse(jsonrpc: "2.0", id: id, result: result)
  send_message(JSON.encode(response))
end

def reject(id: Json, code: Int, message: String) -> Void
  # `error` is a reserved field name, so only this envelope needs a map.
  problem = RpcError(code: code, message: message)
  response = {
    "jsonrpc": JSON.from("2.0"), "id": id, "error": JSON.from(problem)
  }
  send_message(JSON.encode(response))
end

def handle(text: String) -> Void
  parsed = JSON.parse(text)
  if not Result.ok?(parsed)
    reject(JSON.null(), -32700, "Parse error")
    return
  end
  request = Result.unwrap!(parsed)
  envelope = JSON.decode(text, Envelope)
  if not Result.ok?(envelope)
    reject(JSON.null(), -32600, "Invalid Request")
    return
  end
  fields = Result.unwrap!(envelope)
  if fields.jsonrpc != "2.0"
    reject(JSON.null(), -32600, "Invalid Request")
    return
  end

  request_id = JSON.get(request, "id")
  # Notifications, including notifications/initialized, have no response.
  if not Result.ok?(request_id)
    return
  end
  id = Result.unwrap!(request_id)
  if not (Result.ok?(JSON.string(id)) or Result.ok?(JSON.int(id)))
    reject(JSON.null(), -32600, "Invalid Request")
    return
  end

  if fields.method == "initialize"
    params = JSON.get(request, "params")
    if not Result.ok?(params)
      reject(id, -32602, "Invalid params")
      return
    end
    version = JSON.get(Result.unwrap!(params), "protocolVersion")
    if not Result.ok?(version)
      reject(id, -32602, "Invalid params")
      return
    end
    requested = JSON.string(Result.unwrap!(version))
    if not Result.ok?(requested)
      reject(id, -32602, "Invalid params")
      return
    end
    protocol = Result.unwrap!(requested)
    if protocol != "2024-11-05" and protocol != "2025-03-26" and protocol != "2025-06-18" and protocol != "2025-11-25"
      protocol = "2025-06-18"
    end
    result = InitializeResult(
      protocolVersion: protocol,
      capabilities: Capabilities(tools: EmptyObject()),
      serverInfo: ServerInfo(name: "agentica-ping", version: "0.1.0")
    )
    reply(id, JSON.from(result))
  elsif fields.method == "ping"
    reply(id, JSON.from(EmptyObject()))
  elsif fields.method == "tools/list"
    reply(id, JSON.from(ToolsResult(tools: [])))
  else
    reject(id, -32601, "Method not found")
  end
end

def main() -> Void
  while not IO.eof?()
    line = IO.gets()
    if not Result.ok?(line)
      return
    end
    handle(Result.unwrap!(line))
  end
end

examples/traveling-salesman.agc:
struct Circuit
  cost: Int
  route: List[Int]
end

def search(distances: List[List[Int]], visited: List[Bool], path: List[Int], cost: Int, best: Circuit) -> Circuit
  current = path[List.size(path) - 1]
  if List.size(path) == List.size(distances)
    total = cost + distances[current][0]
    if total < best.cost
      return Circuit(cost: total, route: List.append(path, 0))
    end
    return best
  end
  result = best
  city = 1
  while city < List.size(distances)
    if not visited[city]
      next_cost = cost + distances[current][city]
      if next_cost < result.cost
        result = search(distances, List.set(visited, city, true), List.append(path, city), next_cost, result)
      end
    end
    city = city + 1
  end
  return result
end

def read_distances(text: String) -> Result[List[List[Int]]]
  request = try JSON.parse(text)
  rows = try JSON.list(try JSON.get(request, "distances"))
  size = List.size(rows)
  if size < 1 or size > 8
    return error("invalid input")
  end
  distances: List[List[Int]] = []
  row_index = 0
  for row in rows
    cells = try JSON.list(row)
    if List.size(cells) != size
      return error("invalid input")
    end
    values: List[Int] = []
    column = 0
    for cell in cells
      value = try JSON.int(cell)
      if value < 0 or value > 1000000000
        return error("invalid input")
      end
      if row_index == column and value != 0
        return error("invalid input")
      end
      values = List.append(values, value)
      column = column + 1
    end
    distances = List.append(distances, values)
    row_index = row_index + 1
  end
  return ok(distances)
end

def solve(text: String) -> Result[Circuit]
  distances = try read_distances(text)
  visited = List.set(List.repeat(false, List.size(distances)), 0, true)
  best = Circuit(cost: 8000000001, route: [])
  return ok(search(distances, visited, [0], 0, best))
end

def main() -> Void
  result = solve(IO.read())
  if Result.ok?(result)
    puts(JSON.encode(Result.unwrap!(result)))
  else
    puts(JSON.encode({"error": "invalid input"}))
  end
end
